expected_range.method: ATM IV from Vol2Vol smile (1-day move); ATR(14) kept as cross-check
expected_range.note: IV-based 1SD daily move (forward-looking). bands_1d are locked to anchor_price from the Vol2Vol scrape; live/current price is only compared against that anchor.

skew.read: put_skew_stretched_vs_norm (z=+1.5 — fear ABOVE its usual hedge level)

option_flow.note: Successive Vol2Vol intraday-volume snapshot deltas (~10 min cadence). Volume is unsigned — reads describe location/intensity of flow, not aggressor side.

mean_reversion.rationale: Fade VWAP ±2SD back toward VWAP; size up at ±3SD and where a round number / OI wall coincides.

daily_guard.note: 2 stop-outs = -$1000; stop trading for the day. Size from the stop distance, never from conviction.

round_numbers.note: Round numbers within visible strike range (×500 primary, ×100 secondary).

round_walls.note: Round levels every 100 pts whose ±25-pt OI window is in the top quartile of all strike windows in range. Fade at touch, target the next round (100 pts), SL 100 pts (0.25x expected move clamped to 50-100). Edge is unproven until the round_wall scorecard verdict says otherwise.

heatmap_contract_flow.method: latest OI heatmap build-up: newest non-null date minus previous non-null date
heatmap_contract_flow.note: Build tagged via position_map: call build above = growing resistance, put build below = growing support; magnet = largest growing OI pile.

gamma_1pct.method: Gamma (1 Pct) heatmap latest non-null value by strike
gamma_1pct.note: Nearest wall = first speed bump (by distance); major wall = biggest gamma (the real cap); magnet = single largest-gamma strike price gravitates to.

vol2vol_walls.method: Vol2Vol position_map total OI + intraday activity by strike and tenor
vol2vol_walls.note: Use side + activity_vs_oi to distinguish static wall from active wall.

execution_read.contract_build_up: largest fresh OI build at 29475 (current, +199 contracts, above, call → resistance)
execution_read.how_to_use: Heatmap build/magnet = likely destination; gamma 1pct first wall = speed bump, major wall = real cap; confluence levels (≥2 sources) are the highest-conviction strikes.
